Operating Characteristics of the Waterfall Design Across Scenarios

Source: R/sim_waterfall_multi.R
sim_waterfall_multi.Rd

Run sim_waterfall under several matrices of true DLT probabilities with the same design, and collect the main operating characteristics of every scenario in one table.

Usage

sim_waterfall_multi(
  target,
  scenarios,
  cohort_size,
  n_cohort = NULL,
  n_trials = 10000,
  n_earlystop = 12,
  p_saf = NULL,
  p_tox = NULL,
  cutoff_eli = 0.95,
  extrasafe = FALSE,
  offset = 0.05,
  titration = FALSE,
  bound_mtd = FALSE,
  boin_compatible = FALSE,
  keep_trials = FALSE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  seed = 123
)

Arguments

target

Numeric scalar. Target DLT probability, for example 0.30.

scenarios

List of scenarios. Each element is either a matrix of true DLT probabilities, with one row per dose level of drug A and one column per dose level of drug B, or a list with elements name and p_true. Names of the list are used as scenario names. All matrices must have the same dimensions.

cohort_size

Integer scalar. Number of patients per cohort.

n_cohort

Integer vector with one element per dose level of drug A, or NULL. Maximum number of cohorts of the first, second, ... subtrial. Defaults to NULL, which gives every subtrial about four patients per dose of the subtrial (see Details).

n_trials

Integer scalar. Number of trials to simulate. Defaults to 10000.

n_earlystop

Integer scalar. A subtrial ends once this many patients have been treated at the dose chosen for its next cohort. Defaults to 12.

p_saf

Numeric scalar. Highest DLT probability deemed subtherapeutic. Defaults to 0.6 * target.

p_tox

Numeric scalar. Lowest DLT probability deemed overly toxic. Defaults to 1.4 * target.

cutoff_eli

Numeric scalar. Posterior probability cutoff for eliminating a combination. Defaults to 0.95.

extrasafe

Logical scalar. Apply the stricter safety stopping rule at the lowest dose of every subtrial. Defaults to FALSE.

offset

Numeric scalar between 0 and 0.5. Amount by which cutoff_eli is relaxed for the safety stopping rule. Defaults to 0.05.

titration

Logical scalar. Start the first subtrial with one patient per dose, up to the first DLT. Ignored when cohort_size is one. Defaults to FALSE.

bound_mtd

Logical scalar. Require the estimate at the candidate MTD of a subtrial to be below the de-escalation boundary. Defaults to FALSE.

boin_compatible

Logical scalar. Drop the data of a subtrial that ends without a candidate MTD, as BOIN::get.oc.comb() does (see Details). Defaults to FALSE.

keep_trials

Logical scalar. Keep the full trial by trial data in the result. Defaults to FALSE.

verbose

Logical scalar. Report progress while the simulation runs. Defaults to FALSE.

seed

Integer scalar or NULL. Random seed. The state of the calling session is restored on exit. Defaults to 123.

Value

An object of class waterfall_oc_multi, which is a list with components

results

Named list of waterfall_oc objects, one per scenario.

summary_table

Data frame with one row per scenario: the true MTD contour, the percentage of trials selecting exactly that contour, the percentages of patients treated on and above it, the percentage of trials without any MTD, and the average numbers of patients and DLTs.

scenario_names

Character vector of scenario names.

n_rows, n_cols

Numbers of dose levels of drug A and drug B.

call

The matched call.

Details

Every scenario is simulated with the same seed, so that the scenarios differ by their DLT probabilities and not by the random numbers.

References

Zhang, L. and Yuan, Y. (2016). A Practical Bayesian Design to Identify the Maximum Tolerated Dose Contour for Drug Combination Trials. Statistics in Medicine, 35(27), 4924-4936.

See also

sim_waterfall

Examples

scenarios <- list(
  "Contour A1B3, A2B2" = matrix(c(0.03, 0.10, 0.28,
                                  0.10, 0.30, 0.50), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
  "Contour A1B1" = matrix(c(0.30, 0.40, 0.50,
                            0.42, 0.49, 0.55), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
)

oc <- sim_waterfall_multi(
  target = 0.30,
  scenarios = scenarios,
  cohort_size = 3,
  n_trials = 200,
  seed = 123
)
oc
#> Waterfall drug-combination operating characteristics across 2 scenarios
#>   target DLT rate : 0.3
#>   dose levels     : 2 of drug A, 3 of drug B
#>   trials each     : 200
#>   max sample size : 27
#> 
#>            Scenario MTD contour Contour selected (%) Patients on contour (%)
#>  Contour A1B3, A2B2  A1B3, A2B2                 50.0                    50.5
#>        Contour A1B1        A1B1                 55.5                    52.0
#>  Patients above contour (%) No MTD (%) Patients DLTs
#>                         8.8          0     26.9  6.0
#>                        48.0         11     18.2  6.6

# The full results of one scenario
oc$results[["Contour A1B1"]]
